method: Read-only ordinary O2 machine-code analysis of freshly rebuilt baseline A and three-INLINE candidate C from the same batch; no new target execution.

combined_three_module_text.interpretation: Static .text sections including GHC tables, not instruction counts.

mechanism.Primitive_facade_entries: The three public entries remain 5-byte direct jumps; no heap-allocating facade wrapper was removed.
mechanism.ASCII_constructor_change: The 16-byte Int64 code box is replaced by a 24-byte updateable checked-Word8 thunk. Startup constructor 144->152 bytes; steady constructor 152->160 bytes. Other counted scalar-index, position-thunk and successful write components remain.
mechanism.write_order_and_owner: The selected inlined path still demands array then index, checks unsigned bounds before the checked byte value, stores the byte, and retains the ForeignPtr owner via keepAlive.
mechanism.read_path: Actual sameAscii read inlining retains 16-byte index box + 24-byte keepAlive read action + 16-byte Int64 result = 56 bytes.
mechanism.loop_return: Retained recursive tail and next-position thunk return to the actual loop; allocation is not judged from disappearance of the Host call alone.

accounting_limits: The two-character values are conditional static successful-path accounting, not measured heap totals or an ordinary runtime regression.
The 528/544 subtotals exclude position-thunk result boxes; including both gives 560/576. Do not add these two presentations together.
Counts exclude common stringCodeAt internals, arbitrary operand thunks, RTS keepAlive/scheduler/GC internals and unrelated paths.
Reservation rollbacks and both writes/loop returns are included under the original matched ledger convention.
No complete allocation total is claimed for every non-ASCII branch, sameAscii continuation, or other consumer.
Same-batch baseline A objects for these three modules equal the previously inspected ordinary baseline objects, but new candidate paths were traced separately.
decision: Stop this sole three-INLINE candidate: the selected matched recurrence adds 16 local bytes per two ASCII characters and combined text grows. No 95-module build or performance window follows.
